import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Output grid|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for p in ['1','2','3']:
    D=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    bg=D[0][0]; mk=0
    # find marker color: value 0 in D1/D2, 4 in D3
    mks=set(v for r in D for v in r)-set(range(256))
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in D for x in r); bgc=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers=[v for v,n in c.items() if n<=8]
    print(p,'bg',bgc,'markers',markers,'counts',{k:c[k] for k in markers})
    strays=[(i,j,D[i][j]) for i in range(len(D)) for j in range(len(D[0])) if D[i][j]!=bgc and D[i][j] not in markers]
    print('  strays:',strays)
    print('  out:')
    for i,r in enumerate(O): print('   ',''.join(str(x) if x!=O[0][0] else '.' for x in r))
